nextStoryContext: US-R2-002 (CAM-479 review-round fix) closed the remaining half of the gap identified by this PRD's own review artifact: US-R2-001 (previous story) already fixed the production bug in makeEarlyDeathProbe AND added one production-cadence regression test ('regression (US-R2-001): a frozen dead-on-first-turn transcript still fires across many production-cadence poll ticks', test/supervisor/dispatch-early-death.test.ts) that replays the real probe at the real 5_000 ms poll cadence against a frozen DEAD_JSONL fixture for 480 ticks and asserts it eventually fires. That covered the FIRST half of US-R2-002's ask. This story added the SIBLING case the story explicitly also asked for and that was still missing: 'regression (US-R2-002): a transcript that grows every few ticks never fires across many production-cadence poll ticks' -- same 5_000 ms production cadence, same 480-tick (40 simulated minute) duration, but driven against a transcript built from the real HEALTHY_JSONL fixture (normal last-assistant-entry text, not an API error) that is incrementally grown (one appended line) every 3rd tick (15s growth interval, well under the 60s EARLY_DEATH_FLOOR_MS), asserting the detector NEVER reports dead-on-first-turn across the whole run. This closes both halves of the story's acceptance description (fires-when-frozen-past-floor at production cadence, AND never-fires-when-growing-every-few-ticks at production cadence) using the real makeEarlyDeathProbe stateful factory, not the alwaysDeadOnFirstTurn fake every other poll-loop test in this file still injects (that fake is intentionally out of scope here -- it exercises the SUPERVISOR'S handling of an early-death verdict, a different concern from pinning the DETECTOR's own freeze accounting, which is what both regression tests in the 'makeEarlyDeathProbe (stateful)' describe block now do). No production code changed in this story; test-only addition. Quality gates run in full: bun run typecheck (clean), bun test (5913 pass/0 fail, includes the new test), and the full bun run check:all spine (typecheck/test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet, all green, no ceiling raises needed).
